finding_summary: For Apache Kafka 4.2.0, ListTransactionsHandler unconditionally carries an empty filteredProducerIds set into ListTransactionsRequestData, while the protocol schema defines empty ProducerIdFilters as no producer-ID filtering. This confirms there is no handler-level correction to match-none before request construction; generated serializer bytes and live broker behavior remain unverified.
scope_guard: Apache Kafka tag 4.2.0 ListTransactionsHandler.java plus ListTransactionsRequest.json only; no claim about generated serialization byte layout, broker-side decoding/execution, authorization, later client-side filtering, Flink runtime reachability, or other versions.
residual_richer_mode_protected_manual_de: The operational ListTransactions mechanism requires an executing Kafka Admin client plus reachable Kafka authority and is not a zero-residual scheduled-Chat route.
finite_monthly_quota_dependency: none consumed for evidence gathering; Kafka infrastructure quota-freedom not claimed
exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, then inspect exactly one official Apache Kafka 4.2.0 generated-message serializer or protocol serialization-test source family for ListTransactionsRequestData to pin whether ProducerIdFilters=[] is serialized as an explicit zero-length compact array versus another representation. Do not infer live broker behavior from serializer source alone.
